response.description: Azure Files now supports NFS shares on HDD in public preview, expanding beyond the existing SSD offering with a cost-effective, fully managed option for Linux workloads such as general-purpose applications, shared datasets, and backups where cost efficiency is the priority.Key benefits:Align storage spending with workload needs: Choose HDD for cost-sensitive data and SSD for performance-sensitive application data.Retain familiar NFS access: Move Linux workloads from on-premises file servers and NAS environments to a fully managed service.Configure capacity and performance independently: Provision capacity, IOPS, and throughput to match workload requirements with Provisioned v2 billing.To get started, complete the NFS HDD signup survey to request access. For questions or feedback, contact azfilespreview@microsoft.com.Learn more:Azure Files NFS learning documentationNFS HDD signup survey
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Files NFS shares on HDD
